newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans slide in wake of Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans slide in wake of Chicago.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans were lower midsession at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, slouching in line with Chicago prices, traders said.
FAS elevator soybeans lost $7 in Rosario. But volume was low, with farmers stubbornly hoping to squeeze good value out of soybeans now that their other products are cheap.

Spot maize was steady, with good export demand and tight supply keeping up prices. FAS elevator maize was unchanged at $106 in Buenos Aires. Sunflower seed rose $3 to $233 in Buenos Aires and was steady at $230 in Rosario, with good crusher demand and tight supply.
